preregistered.written_before: any block was placed. The site briefing (out/site_f/site.json) and plan.json are the only site_f artefacts that predate this file; no lane had been laid, no wave brief composed and no builder called. The snapshot site_f.before is taken after this file and before the circulation pass.

site.terrain: a drowned inlet in swamp and jungle: water over 58% of the sampled columns at y=62, grass, mud, podzol, bamboo and mangrove at the surface, a rock ridge rising to y=121 along the west edge with cell roughness 36-44, and a dry gravel spur running north-east from the inlet head at y=64-68. All four orientation probes agree with the grid.

walk_from_outdoors_pct.measure:
scripts/walk_fraction.py site_f, from_outdoors_walking_pct over every room on a plot in
the finished town, with the same perimeter seeding rounds 7 to 10 were measured with.
Read against the **corrected** walk model.

e002_walk_only.measure: E002 over the finished town in the round's own lint stage, reading Context.from_outdoors, which is seeded from the lane where a network exists.

own_lint_errors.measure: the build family on each wave's own plots, the way settlement_run scopes it; out/site_f/passes.json

builder_calls.measure: build_request_<i>.json files on disk under out/site_f/arms/site_f/. `split` is on, so a wave costs a massing call and an elaboration call; a bounce is a third and puts the round over.

program_lines.measure: lines of each adopted elaboration program, out/site_f/<wave>.py, meaned over the waves. This is the bar on whether the shell actually moved into the library: a builder still rasterising walls by hand will not come near it.

writes_covered_over.measure: (positions written - blocks standing) / positions written, summed over the adopted programs and re-executed offline against the base volume. The cheap half of placed-versus-attempted.

reported_no_bar.building_calls_and_refusals: every building() call in every adopted program and every refusal with its reason, from scripts/round11_readout.py. A refusal is the library saying what its vocabulary cannot reach, and that list is the next spec.
reported_no_bar.fitting_refusals: the same for fitting(), flight() and dais()
reported_no_bar.forms_used: the form and roof the planner gave each structure, against what stands; out/site_f/plan.json holds the ask
reported_no_bar.true_tokens_per_call: as each isolated subagent reports its own usage. The model_call log under-reads by about six times and must not be quoted as the cost. The planner call was 47,299.
reported_no_bar.judge:
r11_vs_r10 and r11_vs_r7 above: 14 pairs each, both orders, blinded and position-
swapped, on cards shot with the identical E1D geometry. Pairing rule, fixed here before
any frame was rendered. How many losing reasons name a flue or a chimney, and how many
say thin, flat, unfinished, floating, bare, buried or swallowed. **r10_fold_barn has no
card**. Part A7 gives a refused panel a ladder of further-back cameras, so it will be
re-shot under that; if it still refuses, that pair is reported unpaired and r11_vs_r10
is 13 pairs, not 14.
reported_no_bar.a_person_walks_it:
First 'is there anything you cannot get into or move about in on foot, and any stair you
hit your head on?', then 'does this read as a different town from the last two, or the
same in a different font?'

rules_held: nothing beyond part A's items A1-A8; no new lint check; the lint and primitive suites stay frozen
the builder is told the API, the plot, the form and the roof, never what is measured or that anything is compared
rounds 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 are not touched: no block of any of them is written
a miss on any row is reported as a miss and the bar does not move
